audit_title: Earth Pulse — Phase 4A.1: Scientific Provenance and Validation Assumption Audit
project: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Dancing with the SARs

hydrological_constants_audit.remediation: Requires official BWDB/FFWC station registry bulletin and water level log before use in hydraulic corroboration.
Requires official BWDB daily bulletin for Kazipur reach.
Located north of target AOI; preliminary literature reference only.

hydrological_constants_audit.claimed_definition: Standard national hydrological vertical datum in Bangladesh
hydrological_constants_audit.remediation: Document official Survey of Bangladesh (SoB) / BWDB datum definition.
Geodetic datum offset varies regionally; must not be applied without explicit SoB benchmark calibration.

terrain_assumptions_audit.scientific_status: Regional rule-of-thumb; not calibrated against verified in-situ or LiDAR DEM data.

terrain_assumptions_audit.assumption: Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) Threshold (3.0 m)
terrain_assumptions_audit.scientific_status: Hydraulic rule-of-thumb; requires hydrodynamic drainage network calibration.

terrain_assumptions_audit.assumption: Barind Tract Pleistocene Terrace Elevation (> 25.0 m)
terrain_assumptions_audit.scientific_status: Regional geomorphological assumption; no local elevation model present in workspace.
Embankments and bridges create localized micro-shadow, but quantitative masking requires a high-resolution DSM.
Recommended external elevation models; neither dataset exists locally in the workspace.

optical_validation_protocol_audit.band_selections: VERIFIED_SOUND (S2: B03, B08, B11, B12, SCL; Landsat: B3, B5, B6, QA_PIXEL)
optical_validation_protocol_audit.cloud_shadow_masking: VERIFIED_SOUND (SCL classes 3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and QA_PIXEL cloud bits strictly excluded)
optical_validation_protocol_audit.uncertainty_tagging: VERIFIED_SOUND (Optical cloud/shadow mapped to code 255/254 and excluded from denominator)
optical_validation_protocol_audit.spatial_aggregation: VERIFIED_SOUND (Area-weighted aggregation to 20m reference grid EPSG:32645)
optical_validation_protocol_audit.cloud_availability_limitation: EXPLICITLY_DOCUMENTED (> 85% monsoon cloud cover in June-July requires multi-day temporal windows; cloud-free imagery cannot be assumed)

validation_metrics_engine_audit.zero_division_handling: VERIFIED_AND_DOCUMENTED (Explicit class_distribution_flags report precision_undefined, recall_undefined, f1_undefined, and specificity_undefined when validation classes are missing, preventing concealment of missing classes)
validation_metrics_engine_audit.exclusion_handling: VERIFIED_SOUND (Candidate NoData 6, Candidate Indeterminate 5, Reference NoData 255, and Reference Uncertain 254 strictly excluded)
validation_metrics_engine_audit.spatial_block_cross_validation: VERIFIED_SPECIFIED (5 km x 5 km spatial blocks with 500 m halo buffers to prevent spatial autocorrelation data leakage in future ML models)

anti_circular_validation_guard.rule: SAR-derived candidate masks cannot validate SAR-derived candidate masks
anti_circular_validation_guard.implementation: validate_reference_dataset_provenance strictly rejects files originating from Sentinel-1 or backscatter thresholding

audit_verdict.unsupported_constants_remediated: Quarantined and prohibited from automatic operational execution.
